summary: The admitted v76 action first diverged when light_cocktail split one oil potion from a stack and called hold_another_object without the encumberMessage callback. The caller now passes the existing pickup.c:encumber_msg implementation, and the exact 225-step segment matches.

source.branch: For an unlit oil potion stack, light_cocktail splits one child, starts its burn, detaches it, and reacquires it through invent.c:hold_another_object. That helper updates inventory and calls pickup.c:encumber_msg before returning. JavaScript now supplies the existing encumber_msg implementation through the required hook while preserving any explicit hook and the message sink.
callers: apply.c:doapply() POT_OIL calls light_cocktail(&obj); js/apply.js:doapply() awaits light_cocktail and then reads the returned object pointer.
dependencies: invent.c:hold_another_object() is implemented in js/invent.js and invokes the required encumberMessage hook after update_inventory().
pickup.c:encumber_msg() is implemented in js/pickup.js and refreshes go.oldcap after any burden-change message.

evidence: The hosted v76 evaluation had 125/225 screens and cursors matched and 2370/2378 RNG calls matched before stopping at step 125 because hold_another_object lacked encumberMessage.
Upstream apply.c:1704-1765 and invent.c:1208-1293 show the split-child reacquisition order and the call to encumber_msg after inventory refresh; pickup.c:1977-2020 updates the old burden state.
The regression test lights one potion from a three-potion stack and checks the child pointer, remaining stack, both inventory entries, and refreshed go.oldcap.
The exact admitted v76 segment 0 matches through step 224: all 225 recorded screens, RNG calls, and cursors.
selectionReason: Selected synthetic/v76/v76-oil-snuff-merge-action2 from its hosted v76 evaluation. The first mismatch is the split-one reacquisition inside apply.c:light_cocktail(): JS has added the child but refuses before the existing C encumber_msg call because its caller omitted the required hook. The later snuff/merge actions are downstream and are not the first cause.
